## Description

Please include a summary of the change and which issue it fixes. Also list any relevant motivation and context.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the code style and architecture of this project (`ruff check .` passes)
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] All new and existing unit tests pass (`python tests/run.py`)
- [ ] I have updated the documentation accordingly (`README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`)
